findings.claim: enqueue_bulk iterates `items` twice, so passing a one-shot iterator (e.g. a generator expression) silently enqueues nothing after validation succeeds.
findings.failure_scenario: enqueue_bulk(queue, (row for row in rows)) with all valid priorities: the validation loop at line 44 consumes the generator entirely, then the list comprehension at line 49 iterates an exhausted generator, returns [] and leaves queue unmodified, with no exception raised even though every input was valid.

findings.claim: The priority-range check in enqueue_bulk's pre-validation loop duplicates the identical check already performed inside enqueue().
